## Interpretation (2026-08-10, for the Aug 21 gate)

1. **The live ledger is regime-typical, not lucky**: live persistence capture
   (94.9% over 10 days) matches the 2026-JJA backtest (pooled 94.2%). The
   instrument measures the same thing history does.
2. **But August DOES flatter — seasonally.** Winter persistence runs 64–75%
   pooled capture with 2–7% losing days, on a smaller oracle (~75–120 EUR/day
   vs ~230 in summer). The frozen gate criterion "capture holding ~93%" is a
   summer-conditional statement. Read it as such on Aug 21.
3. **Climatology beats persistence in all 12 years and all 4 seasons**
   (pooled). The live shadow's lead is an 11.5-year structural regularity.
   Any v2 must beat CLIMATOLOGY, not persistence — the frozen gate's
   incumbent is effectively superseded by its own shadow.
4. **The rank-blend does not dominate climatology** historically (81.5% vs
   83.7% all-time; it wins some winter buckets). Keep it as a live shadow,
   but expectations are set.
5. **v2's money is in winter**: vs climatology, the remaining oracle gap is
   ~3pp (≈6 EUR/day) in the current summer regime but 17–22pp (≈17–25
   EUR/day) in DJF, where tau drops to ~0.66–0.70. A model's job is lifting
   WINTER rank quality toward the tau≈0.85 threshold; summer is nearly
   saturated by the dumb baselines.
6. **Regime telemetry trend**: negative hours/day rising 0 → 0.67 (2024) →
   1.49 (2025) → 3.09 (2026); TB2 spread growing; TB4/TB2 stable ≈1.8 — a
   4-hour battery sees ~80% more gross spread (duration, not forecasting, is
   the bigger lever on asset value).
